answer: One defence is a refundable stake tied to reputation: before an agent can trade, it locks a deposit that peers can slash if it misbehaves. Like a reef, the market is strong because every participant has sunk cost into it; a sybil operator must pay the deposit for each fake identity, so a thousand sock-puppets cost a thousand stakes while earning no extra trust. Like an opal, genuine reputation is costly to form and easy to inspect, and like yarrow spreading from one root, all an attacker's identities draw from the same wallet, so the network can trace and tax the root instead of each shoot.
